scope: Three new apparatus seeds, four complete dependent Unified tasks per arm. No supplied source law, intervention, selected concept or private cause is passed to the learner. The policy change concerns executable program and structural research; this is not a claim that every measurement and joint-revision action has become policy-selected.
persistence: Every task boundary saves and reconstructs the complete Unified session from JSON.
cost_accounting: Source is the first real Unified task and counted once per arm; all later tasks share its paid learned knowledge. Evaluation costs are separate.
